title: The Thing
blurb: Two adaptations of the same novella, thirty years apart, and a 2011 prequel that ends exactly where the 1982 film begins.

groups.title: The 1951 film
groups.note: A separate, earlier adaptation of the same story.

note: The 2011 film is a prequel set at the Norwegian camp, and its final scene leads straight into the 1982 opening. Watch 1982 first: the prequel spends its runtime explaining what Carpenter left to the imagination.
